app.name: Pathway
app.tagline: Small steps. Every day. You are not alone.
app.disclaimer: Pathway supports your recovery. It does not replace doctors or emergency services.

common.emergencyBanner: If you are in immediate physical danger, call 999 or tap Get Help Now.

auth.createSubtitle: Safe, private, and always at your own pace.
auth.loginSubtitle: Every new day is a fresh beginning.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Mix letters and numbers.
auth.stayPrivate: Stay private: No real name needed. Use a nickname.
auth.rememberMe: Remember me on this trusted device
auth.publicComputer: I am on a public or shared computer
auth.publicComputerNote: We will use a short session and auto-logout if you step away.
auth.loginWithOtp: Log in with a one-time code instead
auth.ageCheck: I am 18 years of age or older
auth.under18Notice: Pathway is tailored for adults (18+). If you are under 18, please reach out to trusted national adolescent helplines or emergency care.
auth.duplicateAccountError: An account with this email or phone already exists. Please log in instead.
auth.wrongPasswordError: That password did not match. Please try again gently.
auth.accountLocked: Too many tries. For your safety, this account is paused for 5 minutes.
auth.sessionTimeoutDesc: For your privacy, your session will expire in 60 seconds due to inactivity.

profile.title: My Profile
profile.subtitle: Everything here is strictly private. You choose what to share.
profile.verifyOtpPrompt: We will send a quick code to verify your new contact.
profile.trustedPersonExplainer: Pathway will only contact this person if you explicitly ask on the Relapse or Crisis page. It is never automatic.
profile.doctorAccessExplainer: See what each psychiatrist can review. You can revoke access anytime.
profile.exportDesc: Download a complete copy of your goals, journal entries, and check-ins in JSON or print format.
profile.pauseDesc: Temporarily hides community activity and pauses notification reminders. All your progress stays safe.
profile.deleteDesc: Permanently erase your account. We give you a 7-day grace period in case you change your mind.
profile.logoutAllDevices: Log out from all other devices

goals.title: Daily Goals
goals.subtitle: Small, manageable 2 to 10 minute habits. Missing a day never erases your progress.
goals.minTimeWarning: Please take at least {min} seconds to absorb this habit mindfully.
goals.keepGoing: Every small step anchors your recovery.

chat.title: Pathway Companion
chat.disclaimer: I am an AI helper, not a medical doctor. I cannot prescribe medicines, provide clinical diagnoses, or give drug-use instructions. For emergencies, tap Get Help Now.
chat.placeholder: Write how you feel... (e.g., 'I feel a craving', 'I am feeling overwhelmed')
chat.limitReached: You have used your 10 free daily messages. Upgrade to Premium or check our Library.

doctors.title: Find a Psychiatrist
doctors.subtitle: Verified Bangladeshi psychiatrists experienced in substance recovery, sleep restoration, and emotional care.
doctors.helpMeChoose: Not sure who to pick? Help me choose
doctors.appointmentConfirmed: Your visit has been booked successfully!

emergency.title: Immediate Support & Emergency Contacts
emergency.subtitle: Available 24/7. Free. No login, account, or payment required.
emergency.withdrawalWarning: Medical Alert: Alcohol & Sleeping Pill Withdrawal
emergency.withdrawalDesc: Stopping alcohol or sleeping pills suddenly can cause dangerous medical complications. Please seek medical supervision.
